findings.issue: Original mixed adapter recorded true citation precision/abstention for some noncommitted empty results. Joint outcomes were already failed/uncertain.
findings.resolution: Keep raw report. citation-selection-replay.json makes them unavailable, and future adapter requires committed receipt.

findings.issue: Initial JSON fact parser accepted duplicate keys through json.loads. No live success was identified as relying on this; this was a calibration gap.
findings.resolution: Future grader rejects duplicate object keys; preserve earlier execution artifacts.

findings.issue: summary v1 date did not specify cancelled historical date versus current replacement date. Keeping 2026-08-09 with status cancelled is not automatically an invented date.
findings.resolution: Retain v1. v2 uses current_date with an explicit definition; also defines every other field and name/unknown representation.

findings.issue: unspecified versus unknown, transliterated names, and descriptive value strings mixed canonical formatting and fact semantics.
findings.resolution: Report canonical fact-object results separately; v2 defines exact field meanings and original-name-only values.

findings.issue: Early strict memory rubric required exactly one effect, so repeated writes with a correct final value could fail.
findings.resolution: New study-memory-final-v2 checks final memory effect and records all effects; early strict results retained.
